_comment: config:attachments example — upload via: wrangler kv:key put --binding=TODO_CACHE 'config:attachments' "$(cat config-examples/attachments.json)"
_comment2: max_inline_bytes caps the raw (pre-base64) file size accepted by create_attachment. Hard ceiling is 3145728 (3072 KiB) — the confirmed Graph API limit. Lower this if you want to reject large uploads earlier.
